steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism – the build-up of armed forces and glorification of military power.  
2. Complex alliance systems – rival blocs (Triple Entente vs. Triple Alliance) that drew nations into conflict.  
3. Imperialism – competition among European powers for colonies and global influence.
